timeline: Nora arrives at Agnes Vance's shuttered hotel with playback equipment.
Nora listens to and digitizes tapes; hears her name whispered after stopping the tape.
Nora explores the hotel and notices the dead sound quality in the back corridor.
Nora discovers the Salt Room at the end of the corridor, where the air is sharply cold and salt is dusted across the threshold.
At the Salt Room threshold, Nora sees the tape counter click from 007 to 008 while the machine is unplugged.
Nora notices the Salt Room door has opened one inch despite being locked moments earlier.
Nora inspects the salt ridge and finds it carefully laid with no footprints or smears.
Nora hears the unplugged tape counter click again to 009.
Nora backs away from the Salt Room without crossing the salt or turning her back on the door.
Nora finds a hidden key behind the scratched photograph and a folded tag labeled SALT ROOM in Agnes's handwriting.
Ruth calls Nora and warns her not to sleep in the Salt Room tonight, then the call ends.
Nora opens the Salt Room door with the hidden key and records evidence from the hallway.
Nora's recorder plays back a click at second eleven that Nora did not hear in the hallway.
Nora places a recorder and a glass of tap water just outside the salt ridge as a baseline test.
Nora photographs and records the Salt Room threshold, salt ridge, door-width gap, floorboards, and hinge scratch.
Nora steps over the salt threshold into the Salt Room.
Cold closes around Nora's ankles immediately after she crosses the threshold.
Nora's breath fogs inside the Salt Room while the glass of water outside the threshold remains unchanged.
Nora extracts a fragment from a damaged tape splice and isolates two distinct breaths; spectral comparison confirms the second breath belongs to a different child.
Nora measures the scratched photograph and finds the erased child is two inches shorter, dressed identically; Agnes wrote 'Girls, first week' on the back.
Nora enters the Salt Room and discovers two sets of pencil height marks on the wall above the first bed frame: one at her height with initial N, another two inches lower with initial sanded away.
Nora examines the second bed area, finding a rug outline, worn floor, three parallel scratches on the wall, and concentrated cold that causes her breath to fog more heavily there.
Nora records a voice memo concluding the room was arranged for two children, with one child erased from all surface evidence.
Nora exits the Salt Room, closing the door; the cold releases gradually.
Nora identifies the whisper on Tape 1 as her own childhood voice through formant analysis, recognizing the breathing pattern as Agnes's exercise.

Nora re-examines the back corridor and discovers that the salt at the Salt Room threshold has spread, with fine grains tracking into the hallway as if someone walked through them, despite Nora not touching the salt.

Nora completes her examination of the damaged tape splice and discovers the original splice of Tape 3, revealing two girls' voices and the name Della.
Ruth calls Nora back and tells her to burn the evidence — the tape, labels, index cards.
Nora confronts Ruth about knowing Della's name and her role in the cover-up.
Ruth admits she knew about Della and was trying to protect Nora from carrying a dead twin.
Nora states she doesn't remember drowning or a funeral, but the room remembers.
Ruth offers to tell a comforting version of events, but the offer hangs as a falsified story.
Ruth calls Nora again, warning her not to follow Agnes's codes and mentioning a guest map hidden under the counter; she tells Nora to burn the map.
Nora reflects on her loneliness and the desire for a partner.
Nora walks through the corridor to the Salt Room, noticing the salt tracked out from the threshold.
Nora enters the Salt Room and decides to search for the guest map in the filing cabinet.
The drawer of the filing cabinet is stuck due to humidity; Nora braces to open it.
